oneOf.description: Line feed.
Carriage return, line feed.
Carriage return.

indentWidth.description: The number of characters for an indent.

indentStyle.description: Whether to use tabs or spaces.

oneOf.description: Use tabs.
Use spaces.

lineWidth.description: How many characters can be written on a single line.

oneOf.description: Semicolons are always added at the end of each statement.
Semicolons are added only in places where it's needed, to protect from ASI.

quoteStyle.description: The type of quote used when representing string literals. Applies to JS/TS, CSS/SCSS/Less, JSON5, YAML, and Markdown.

oneOf.description: Use double quotes.
Use single quotes.

jsxQuoteStyle.description: The type of quote used in JSX attributes.

oneOf.description: Use double quotes.
Use single quotes.

quoteProperties.description: Whether property names inside objects should be quoted. Applies to JS/TS and JSON5.

oneOf.description: Quotes when necessary.
Maintains quotes on properties.
All properties are quoted if any property requires quoting.

arrowParentheses.description: Whether to add non-necessary parentheses to arrow functions.

oneOf.description: Parentheses are always added.
Parentheses are added only when necessary.

trailingCommas.description: Print trailing commas wherever possible in multi-line comma-separated syntactic structures. Outside of JS/TS, "all" and "es5" are the same and this applies to JSONC, JSON5, SCSS maps, YAML flow collections, and TOML arrays.

oneOf.description: Trailing commas are always added.
Trailing commas are added only in places where it's supported in ES5.
Trailing commas are never added.

bracketSpacing.description: Surround the inner contents of some braces with spaces. Applies to JS/TS, JSON, GraphQL, and YAML.

bracketSameLine.description: Place the last angle bracket in JSX tags on the same line as the last attribute.

oneOf.description: Attributes are automatically positioned.
Each attribute is placed on its own line.

expand.description: Whether to expand object and array literals to multiple lines. Applies to JS/TS and JSON.

oneOf.description: Objects are expanded when the first property has a leading newline. Arrays are always collapsed unless they contain a newline.
Objects and arrays are never expanded, if they are shorter than the line width.

operatorPosition.description: Controls the position of operators in binary expressions when they wrap lines.

oneOf.description: Places the operator at the beginning of the next line.
Places the operator at the end of the current line.

experimentalTernaries.description: [EXPERIMENTAL - NOT FULLY SUPPORTED] Try prettier's new ternary formatting before it becomes the default behavior.

htmlWhitespaceSensitivityIgnore.description: Whether HTML-in-JS templates always use hard line breaks for wrapping.

experimentalMarkdown.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Whether to format Markdown files. This is opt-in because Oxc's Markdown formatter is not yet used by oxfmt. Code blocks and front matter in Markdown files are not formatted.

proseWrap.description: How to wrap prose in YAML and Markdown.

oneOf.description: Keep the line breaks as they are.
Wrap prose when it exceeds the line width.
Unwrap each block of prose onto a single line.

embeddedLanguageFormatting.description: Whether to format code embedded in a file (ex. CSS or GraphQL in a JS template literal, code blocks in JSDoc comments, or front matter in CSS).

oneOf.description: Format embedded code when its language is identified.
Never format embedded code.

insertFinalNewline.description: Whether to end files with a newline.

sortPackageJson.description: Whether to sort the properties of package.json files. May be a boolean or an object of options.

sortScripts.description: Whether to sort the scripts alphabetically.

jsdoc.description: Enable JSDoc comment formatting. May be a boolean or an object of options.

oneOf.description: Enables it with the default options when true.

capitalizeDescriptions.description: Capitalize the first letter of tag descriptions.

commentLineStrategy.description: How to format JSDoc comment blocks.

oneOf.description: Convert to a single line when possible.
Always use multiple lines.
Preserve the original line layout.

separateTagGroups.description: Add blank lines between different tag groups.

separateReturnsFromParam.description: Add a blank line between the last @param and @returns.

bracketSpacing.description: Add spaces inside JSDoc type braces.

descriptionWithDot.description: Add a trailing dot to descriptions.

preferCodeFences.description: Use fenced code blocks for code without a language tag.

lineWrappingStyle.description: How JSDoc description lines wrap at the configured line width.

oneOf.description: Always re-wrap text to fit the line width.
Keep original line breaks when they fit.

descriptionTag.description: Emit an @description tag instead of an inline description.

sortImports.description: Sort import statements. May be a boolean or an object of options.

oneOf.description: Enables it with the default options when true.
Sort in ascending order (A-Z).
Sort in descending order (Z-A).

newlinesBetween.description: Whether to insert blank lines between different import groups.

newlineBoundaryOverrides.description: Whether to insert blank lines at each boundary between import groups. A null value uses newlinesBetween.

groups.description: The groups to sort the imports into. Each item is a group name, an array of group names that are sorted together, or a `{ "newlinesBetween": boolean }` marker that overrides whether there is a blank line between the groups before and after it.

customGroups.description: Definitions for custom import groups referenced by groups.

elementNamePattern.description: Glob patterns that match import sources.

selector.description: The import selector that must match.

modifiers.description: Import modifiers that must all be present.

sortTailwindcss.description: Collect Tailwind CSS classes for sorting. May be a boolean or an object of options. Note that the classes are not reordered because oxc only implements the sorter in JS.

oneOf.description: Enables it with the default options when true.

functions.description: Custom functions to sort classes in.

attributes.description: Custom attributes to sort classes in.
